cpu.scope: CPU solver only, after 30 warmup frames; no draw/upload cost
cpu.rest: full bloom with authored cluster transforms and shared production pin initialization
cpu.percentile: median averages samples29/30; p95 nearest rank uses sample56 after sorting sixty samples (zero-indexed)
cpu.limits: both cage tiers run on this same CPU; excludes per-frame rest/articulation preparation, deformation transfer, instanced tissue, browser/GPU cost and render cadence; no physical-phone/FPS claim

rendering.scope: Playwright emulation; approximate R3F advance cadence through 30-frame bins and 50ms polling/RPC; each view warms at least 60 new advances then samples 120; live solver/CPU texture preparation counters become EWMA after 60 calls and carry across views; optional WebGPU disabled
